title: Huntington Beach Cleanup with Veterans!
desc: Open to anyone. Join veterans and volunteers for a 2.5 hour community cleanup on Huntington Beach.
location: 405 Pacific Coast Hwy, Huntington Beach, CA 92648
body: Doors open at 6:45 AM, cleanup from 9:00 to 11:30 AM, optional 21+ veteran social afterward. Gloves and bags provided.

title: World Ocean Day Beach Cleanup
desc: Celebrate World Ocean Day with a hands-on beach cleanup at Newport Beach Pier.
location: Newport Beach Pier, 1 Newport Pier, Newport Beach, CA 92663
body: 9:00 AM - 12:00 PM. Bring sunscreen, comfy shoes, and friends. Family friendly.

title: LBC Beach Cleanup
desc: Community cleanup at 72nd Place in Long Beach. Food and refreshments provided.
body: 9:00 AM - 10:00 AM. Gloves and trash bags provided. Easy parking at the 72nd lot.
